dedupe_keys.name: annual datasets on the future photovoltaic power potential over east asia from five rcms participating in the cordex east asia phase ii project by emission scenarios

description: Annual datasets on the future photovoltaic power potential over East Asia from five RCMs participating in the CORDEX–East Asia Phase Ⅱ project by emission scenarios is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Changyong Park, Ana Juzbašić (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology). Future changes in East Asian photovoltaic power potential (PVpot) for mean and extreme temperature conditions were estimated using five different RCMs with 25–km horizontal resolution forced by UKESM1 (UK's Earth System Model version 1) one of the CMIP6 (Coupled Model Intercomparison Project 6) GCMs (Global Climate Models), participating in the CORDEX–East Asia phase Ⅱ project. Coverage: continental (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
